title: Affogato Cream
desc: Matte terracotta meets the soft breath of warm linen in an intimate, moody coffee studio. Two handcrafted ceramic bowls hold dense spheres of vanilla bean gelato, glistening under directional window daylight as a rich, viscous stream of hot dark espresso strikes the frozen surface, triggering a turbulent marble diffusion of melting cream and golden crema.
businessBrief: Macro bubble dynamics and botanical freshness highlighting craft distillers, tonic brands, and modern luxury hospitality.
